verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own real-time conversational 'Characters' feature with Avatars and custom voices (runway-docs-7, runway-probe-1), alongside voice generation and voice cloning (runway-docs-25, runway-docs-26). Together these suggest generated characters that speak, but the evidence never states that lip movement is synchronized to audio. It also never shows a creator supplying their own scripted dialogue rather than an AI conversation. Missing for 10: explicit documented lip-sync to supplied audio, a workflow for scripted user dialogue, output-quality detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
